ambient_chatter.text: anyone else smell rain coming over {town}? the sacred hen says it means a flood. she is never wrong about floods xD
lag in {village} is so bad my horse is buffering. i have filed a complaint with the horse :(
the brollo bridge looked at me funny again today. nobody tell it i know :)
reminder that the calvenza canal is still technically a lake. i do not make the rules xD

ambient_brag.text: {troop_count} men at {fief} and not one of them can spell their own name. proud of them anyway :)
i have {gold} gold and i spent all of it on hats. no regrets, only more hats xD
{troop_count} soldiers marched into {fief} today. the enemy saw them and suddenly remembered urgent business elsewhere :)
just counted my {gold} gold with my toes. the hen helped. she is very proud of me xD

beat_by_player.text: {player} won at the field again?? the sacred hen has been informed and she is disappointed in all of us :)
{player} ok fine you won this round. i lost on purpose to make the story better. ur sword is still a stick
ha, {player}! you beat me with {troop_count} men and a face like that? legendary. i will be back, probably with a fake beard :)
well played {player}. lost {troop_count} men to you and somehow i feel great about it?? the hen says its fine :)

beat_player.text: {player} got beat by me and {troop_count} men with my own two hands (and a lot of luck) xD. the brollo bridge has been warned about you
{player} that was too easy. i won with {gold} gold worth of hats in my pockets. dont worry, the hen will forgive you
{player}!! you fought bravely, you lost badly, and you will be fed. i saw {troop_count} men fall and i am thrilled for you xD
{player} lost {troop_count} men and a dignity i just made up. the hen has ruled in my favor :)

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw me coming and suddenly remembered they had somewhere to be. classic :) the hen is watching you run
{player} i saw you run. you can run but the sacred hen will find you. you have been warned :)
{player} fled from me like a sensible person. respect. i will leave you alone for at least four minutes xD
{player} the road is a lot less fun without you running from me. come back and fight, coward?? ok fine, i will just wait :(

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights the server is starting to think they are a weather event. dont get a big head, get a bigger helmet xD
{player} ok ok you are on a streak, i am impressed and also jealous. please lose one so the rest of us can have a turn :)
{player} keeps winning and i am choosing to take it personally. the bridge at brollo is tired of your nonsense too
{player} your winning streak is a crime against the sacred hen. she demands a rematch. i demand a sandwich xD

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace?? i had a whole speech ready and now it is wasted :( i will save it for later
peace between {my_faction} and {faction} means no more fights, which means no more fun for me. i am devastated and also happy? both :)
{faction} and {my_faction} shook hands. the hen was not consulted and she is very upset about it xD
{my_faction} is at peace with {faction} now. the bridge at brollo remains on my list of people i am not at peace with

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war on {enemy_faction}. i have packed three snacks and a very small flag xD
war between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}?? finally, something to do besides the canal :)
{enemy_faction} has been declared an enemy of {my_faction}. the sacred hen has blessed this war, do not argue with her

encounter_greeting.text: {player}! halt, it is {persona} of {my_faction}, and you owe the sacred hen an apology. also your banner has been reclassified as a hat, sorry not sorry xD
{player}, fancy meeting you on the road. i am {persona} of {my_faction}, self-appointed chicken enforcer. state your business or your hat xD
{player}!! my favorite person who is not a chicken. want to trade snacks or shall we fight? both is fine :)
{player} the bridge at brollo sent me. it wants a word. so do i, actually, i have many words for you :(

whisper_taunt.text: {player} i heard you lost to {rival} again. no pressure but the hen is already writing a song about it xD
{player} the sacred hen blessed my army today and she said your army is a hat. i am only the messenger :)
{player} you and {rival} should start a club for people who lose at the bridge. i will be the president, obviously
{player} tell {rival} the brollo bridge sends regards. it does not, but i do, and i am thrilled about it xD
